name: merge-strength-opens-branch-db-under-spec-lock
body: `merge_strength_check` reads the scanned universe from the branch `db.lbug` through `code_universes` while holding the extended spec flock; that is safe only because `project_merge_at` has already refused a live session and the merge act is the exclusive writer — the plan paths rely on the same serialization. Upgrade if a future caller ever invokes merge strength outside the session-exclusive merge act, since it would then open a database a live session may own.
